summary: CometAPI (an OpenAI-compatible multi-model API gateway) credits new accounts $0.1 USD in the Wallet after register and login, with no extra claim step. Docs describe pay-as-you-go top-ups via Stripe with a $10 minimum; they do not require a card to receive the signup credit. A final call can exceed the remaining balance and leave it negative; the docs instruct users to top up before continuing. Monitor model costs rather than treating the signup credit as a guaranteed hard spending cap.
claim_steps: Register and log in to CometAPI.
Open the Wallet page; the $0.1 USD credit is applied automatically.
Create an API token under Tokens to call supported models via api.cometapi.com.
Monitor costs and balance: the last call can exceed remaining credit and leave a negative balance. The docs require top-up to continue; Stripe top-ups have a $10 minimum.

social_proof.title: Configure CometAPI account, billing, and base URL
social_proof.text: How to claim the $0.1 USD credit? No special operation required. After registering and logging in, you can see the $0.1 USD credit in your Wallet page.
